ops.en: authoritarian, overbearing, or domineering in the exercise of control; also literally characteristic of a dictator
ops.cn: 专横的；独断的；以权威方式强行控制的；也可指独裁者式的

ops.en: to leave the main subject temporarily in speaking, writing, or thought and discuss something else
ops.cn: 离题；暂时偏离谈话、写作或思考的主题

ops.en: old and in severe disrepair because of age, wear, or neglect, especially of a building or structure
ops.cn: 破败失修的；因年久或疏于维护而严重损坏的，尤指建筑

ops.en: to become wider or larger, especially of a pupil, blood vessel, or opening
ops.cn: 扩张；变宽、变大，尤指瞳孔、血管或开口

ops.en: to make a pupil, blood vessel, opening, or other structure wider or larger
ops.cn: 使扩张；使变宽或变大

ops.en: very or unusually small
ops.cn: 极小的；小巧的

ops.note: Linguistic diminutive: a word form indicating smallness, affection, or related nuance.

ops.en: the management of international relations through negotiation and communication
ops.cn: 外交；通过谈判与沟通处理国际关系

ops.en: skill and tact in dealing with people or difficult situations without causing offense or conflict
ops.cn: 处事圆融；与人或复杂情境打交道的策略与分寸

ops.en: to deny responsibility, knowledge, association, or acceptance of something
ops.cn: 否认承担责任、知情、有关联或接受某事

ops.en: to renounce or give up a legal claim, right, title, or interest
ops.cn: 放弃法律上的权利、主张、所有权或利益

ops.en: to make someone uneasy, confused, embarrassed, or lose confidence or composure
ops.cn: 使不安、困惑、尴尬或失去镇定

ops.en: to regard someone or something as beneath one's dignity or worthy of contempt, or to refuse something scornfully
ops.cn: 鄙视；认为某人/某事不屑一顾；轻蔑地拒绝

ops.meaning_cn: 不屑做某事；轻蔑地拒绝做某事

ops.en: the process or state of breaking into parts, falling apart, or losing coherence and organization, physically or socially/institutionally
ops.cn: 瓦解；分裂；崩解；可指物理破碎或社会/制度组织性的丧失

ops.en: impartial and unbiased because one has no personal interest or stake in the outcome
ops.cn: 公正无私的；因无个人利害关系而保持客观的

ops.value: disinterested = impartial because one has no personal stake; uninterested = not interested. Keep them distinct.

ops.en: gloomy or depressing, or very bad and unsatisfactory
ops.cn: 阴沉令人沮丧的；糟糕透顶的、表现很差的

ops.en: to speak of or represent someone or something as inferior, unimportant, or unworthy
ops.cn: 贬低；贬损；把某人或某事说得低劣、不重要或不值得

ops.en: formal: argumentative or inclined to dispute, disagree, or quarrel
ops.cn: （正式）好争辩的；好与人争论的

ops.en: argumentative or inclined to dispute or quarrel; formal
ops.cn: （正式）好争辩、好争吵的

ops.en: to examine or analyze a subject, argument, performance, or problem in great detail
ops.cn: 深入剖析；细致分析

ops.note: Literal/anatomical sense: cut open or separate into parts for examination.

ops.en: to conceal one's true motives, feelings, beliefs, or intentions behind a false appearance
ops.cn: 掩饰真实动机、感情、信念或意图；装假

ops.en: unpleasant, offensive, or objectionable to one's feelings, taste, or sense of what is acceptable
ops.cn: 令人不快的；令人反感或难以接受的

ops.en: to swell or become enlarged, especially because of internal pressure
ops.cn: 膨胀；因内部压力而鼓起、扩大

ops.en: to cause something to swell or enlarge, especially by internal pressure
ops.cn: 使膨胀；使因内部压力而扩大

ops.en: to reveal or disclose secret, private, or previously unknown information to someone
ops.cn: 泄露；透露秘密、私密或此前未知的信息

ops.en: to avoid a person, question, responsibility, blow, obstacle, or danger, often by quick movement or evasive action
ops.cn: 躲开；闪避；逃避某人、问题、责任、打击或障碍

ops.note: Noun: an evasive answer or trick for avoiding a question or responsibility.

ops.en: a belief, doctrine, or set of beliefs accepted as authoritative by a religion, ideology, organization, or school of thought
ops.cn: 教义；被宗教、意识形态、组织或思想流派视为权威的信念体系

ops.en: a doctrine accepted as authoritative within a religious tradition
ops.cn: 宗教传统中被视为权威的教义

ops.en: expressing beliefs or opinions as unquestionably true and being unwilling to consider alternatives
ops.cn: 教条主义的；武断地把自己的观点视为不可质疑且不愿考虑其他可能

ops.note: Also relating to an authoritative doctrine or code of beliefs.

ops.en: to distribute something in small amounts or portions
ops.cn: 少量分发；一点一点地发放

ops.pattern: dole out sth / dole sth out

ops.en: British English: state unemployment or welfare benefit
ops.cn: （英式英语）失业救济金或国家福利金

ops.note: Older noun for a charitable share or handout.

ops.en: to tame and breed an animal so that it lives with or is useful to humans
ops.cn: 驯化、驯养动物

ops.en: to adapt an animal, plant, practice, or person to domestic life, cultivation, or human use
ops.cn: 使适应家庭生活、栽培或人类使用

ops.en: trying to control other people in an overbearing, bossy, or authoritarian way
ops.cn: 专横跋扈的；喜欢强势控制他人的

ops.en: sad, discouraged, or dejected
ops.cn: 沮丧的；垂头丧气的

ops.en: directed downward, especially of the eyes or gaze
ops.cn: 低垂的；尤指目光向下的

ops.en: to soak or wet something completely, or pour a large amount of liquid over it
ops.cn: 浸透；淋透；用大量液体浇湿

ops.note: Force-to-drink/dose use is rare and specialist.

ops.en: to work hard for a long time at dull, menial, or tedious tasks
ops.cn: 苦干；长时间做单调、卑微或乏味的工作

ops.en: a person who does hard, dull, or menial work
ops.cn: 做苦工或单调卑微工作的人

ops.meaning_cn: 埋头苦干；长期做乏味工作
